fields.symptom: terminal text wrapped at the wrong width (narrow lines in a wide pane; stray chars down the right edge) right after the header-fix build
fields.root_cause: not the header change: PTY size follows the pane identically with and without it; the wrapped text was output written while the pane was narrow (grid) or redrawn mid-resize, which a terminal does not re-wrap
whys: TJ relaunched into the new build and switched layouts while the Mac was under heavy CPU load
fields.corrective: none needed for terminal sizing; the header overlay was replaced by an interim compact header on TJ's later feedback
fields.preventive: driven before/after comparison of PTY size and terminal capture when a terminal glitch follows a layout change
fields.gate: manual: when a rendering report follows an app build

answers.observed: old-r1/ovl-r1 grid=126x36 single, 53x22 grid; t-single/t-relaunch captures equal in both
answers.cause: measured for sizing; the account of TJ's wrap (old narrow output, resize under load) is a hypothesis, not reproduced
answers.absence: my fake prints plain lines, not Claude Code's TUI, so a TUI-specific resize race could be missed
answers.assumption: TJ's installed build at 07:06 was HEAD 23288eb (binary size matched mine)
answers.falsify: the wrap reproducing with the pre-change build absent and present only with the overlay build would falsify it
